lotus-01.title: Lotus Base & Calyx
lotus-01.subtitle: Foundation waterbomb-blintz hybrid • 8-point calyx locking
lotus-01.description: The waterproof architectural foundation of the lotus bloom. Creates a sturdy, freestanding 8-leaf calyx with recessed interlocking sockets for petal tiers.

steps.title: Diagonal Guideline Crease 1
steps.instruction: Place green calyx paper flat on the desk. Fold corner to corner into a triangle and unfold.
steps.tip: Crisp diagonal definition.

steps.title: Diagonal Guideline Crease 2
steps.instruction: Fold across the opposite diagonal and unfold.
steps.tip: X-crease crosses the center.

steps.title: Primary 4-Corner Blintz Fold
steps.instruction: Fold all four outer corners inward to meet at the central intersection.
steps.tip: Points meet flush.

steps.title: Pancake Flip (Turn Paper Over)
steps.instruction: Flip the blintzed square over like a pancake so the smooth side faces up.
steps.tip: Keep edges aligned square.

steps.title: Secondary 4-Corner Blintz Fold
steps.instruction: Fold all four new corners inward to the center again to form the second tier of calyx pockets.
steps.tip: Crease firmly through all layers.

steps.instruction: Open each of the four corner pockets and squash them flat into symmetrical diamond facets.
steps.tip: Press flat from center to point.

steps.title: Sepal Flap Reverse Lifts
steps.instruction: Carefully reach behind each corner and lift the outer green sepal flaps upward at 45 degrees.
steps.tip: The four sepals cradle the lotus flower.

steps.title: Inner Flower Socket Accordion Pleats
steps.instruction: Pinch narrow accordion pleats into the inner cavity to create a snug friction socket for the blossom.
steps.tip: The socket securely holds the flower core.

steps.title: Sepal Outer Rim Organic Curving
steps.instruction: Curl the tips of all four green sepals gently outward over your thumb to replicate botanical sepals.
steps.tip: Soft curves provide natural organic realism.

steps.title: Underside Water Buoyancy Pocket Folds
steps.instruction: Fold the underside corners inward to create a wide, stable base that floats flat on water surfaces.
steps.tip: Wide base prevents tipping.

steps.title: Connecting Interlocking Stem Tabs
steps.instruction: Fold the bottom connector tab to lock securely into the garden water pavilion armature.
steps.tip: Enables modular assembly with other garden components.

steps.title: Radial Calyx Symmetry Alignment
steps.instruction: Inspect all four sepals from above to ensure balanced 90-degree radial symmetry.
steps.tip: Symmetry frames the blossom perfectly.

steps.title: 3D Lotus Base & Calyx Presentation
steps.instruction: Your architectural Lotus Calyx is completed, ready to receive the blooming lotus flower!
steps.tip: A solid botanical foundation.

steps.instruction: Fold corner to corner across the diagonal to form a large crisp triangle.

steps.title: Unfold Flat (Diagonal Crease Memory)
steps.instruction: Unfold the paper back into a flat square. Notice the sharp valley crease down the middle.
steps.tip: Keep the paper flat on the table with the crease pointing toward you.

steps.title: Opposite Diagonal Fold (Twin Triangle)
steps.instruction: Fold the other two corners together across the opposite diagonal to form a twin triangle.
steps.tip: Press firmly along the bottom edge.

steps.title: Unfold Flat (The X-Crease)
steps.instruction: Unfold the paper flat again. You should now have an X-shaped crease across the square.
steps.tip: Both diagonal lines should cross cleanly in the exact center.

steps.title: Pancake Flip (Turn Paper Over)
steps.instruction: Flip your paper over like a pancake so the colored side is now facing up.
steps.tip: The X-creases will now be mountain ridges popping slightly toward you.

steps.title: Horizontal Book Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the top edge down to meet the bottom edge in half, like closing a book.
steps.tip: Line up the corners squarely before pressing the horizontal crease.

steps.title: Vertical Book Fold (The Grid)
steps.instruction: Unfold flat, then fold the left edge across to meet the right edge in half.
steps.tip: All four crease lines (X and +) meet at the center point.

steps.title: Preliminary Square Base Collapse
steps.instruction: Bring the four outer corners together to collapse the paper into a small square diamond.
steps.tip: Push gently inward on the side creases and the paper will naturally collapse.

steps.title: Right Edge Centerline Fold (Kite Wing)
steps.instruction: Take the front right edge and fold it inward to line up flush with the vertical center line.
steps.tip: Make sure the open points are at the bottom and the closed point is at the top.

steps.title: Left Edge Centerline Fold (Twin Kite Wing)
steps.instruction: Take the front left edge and fold it inward to meet the center crease, matching the right side.
steps.tip: Your paper now looks like an ice cream cone on the front.

steps.title: Top Apex Pre-Crease
steps.instruction: Fold the top small triangle downward over the edges, crease firmly, then unfold it.
steps.tip: This horizontal crease is the secret hinge for the petal fold in the next step.

steps.title: Front Petal Diamond Fold
steps.instruction: Unfold the two side wings, lift the bottom corner upward like opening a flower, and press flat into a long diamond.
steps.tip: The sides will naturally fold inward along your pre-creased lines.

steps.title: Turn Over & Back Petal Fold
steps.instruction: Flip the paper over like a pancake and repeat the petal fold on the other side to form the Bird Base.
steps.tip: You now have a two-legged diamond with four long points.

steps.title: Centerline Narrowing Tapers
steps.instruction: Fold the lower outer edges of both front and back legs inward to the center line to narrow them.
steps.tip: These slender tapered points will become the crane's graceful neck and tail.

steps.title: Neck & Tail Inside Reverse Folds
steps.instruction: Inside-reverse-fold both slender points upward between the layers, angling one for the neck and one for the tail.

japanese-02.title: Kabuto — Samurai Warlord Helmet

japanese-02.description: Traditional helmet worn by ancient samurai warlords and folded for Tango no Sekku (Boys' Day / Children's Day). Features flared horns and a wearable hollow dome.

steps.title: Diagonal Foundation (The Giant Triangle)
steps.instruction: Place square paper flat with the colored side facing down. Fold the bottom corner up to the top corner into a crisp triangle.
steps.tip: Align the tips with exact precision and slide your index finger across the fold.

steps.title: Unfold Flat (Diagonal Crease Memory)
steps.instruction: Unfold the paper back into a flat square. Check the clean, sharp crease running corner to corner.
steps.tip: Keep the crease pointing diagonally toward you on the desk.

steps.title: Refold Diagonal Triangle
steps.instruction: Fold along the diagonal crease again to return to the large triangular shape.
steps.tip: Ensure the flat base edge sits closest to you with the single apex pointing away.

steps.title: Twin Corner Apex Folds (The Diamond)
steps.instruction: Fold both the bottom-left and bottom-right sharp corners upward to meet the top apex point, creating a square diamond.
steps.tip: Both corners should meet cleanly in the middle without overlapping.

steps.title: Diamond Flap Downward Inversion
steps.instruction: Fold both front triangular flaps straight down so their tips touch the bottom corner of the diamond.
steps.tip: Keep the edges parallel to the vertical center line.

steps.title: Samurai Horn Outward Flare (Maedate)
steps.instruction: Fold the lower tips of the two flaps diagonally outward at a 45-degree angle to create the proud warlord horns.
steps.tip: Make sure both horns flare symmetrically for a majestic helmet silhouette.

steps.title: Front Visor Primary Valley Fold
steps.instruction: Take only the top layer of the bottom corner and fold it upward, stopping about halfway up the diamond.
steps.tip: This creates the wide protective visor of the samurai helmet.

steps.title: Visor Rim Hemming Lock
steps.instruction: Fold the lower band of the visor upward one more time over itself to lock the brow rim securely in place.
steps.tip: Press firmly with your thumbnail to form a razor-sharp, durable edge.

steps.title: Turn Over Pancake Flip
steps.instruction: Flip your entire model over like a pancake so the flat, smooth back side is facing up.
steps.tip: The samurai horns will now point outward on the sides beneath the model.

steps.title: Rear Hem Valley Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the remaining single bottom triangular flap upward toward the top apex.
steps.tip: Crease firmly across the base of the helmet opening.

steps.title: Inside Reverse Rim Pocket Tuck
steps.instruction: Tuck the bottom flap securely inside the hollow pocket of the helmet so it is completely hidden.
steps.tip: This locks the entire helmet structure together without glue or tape.

steps.title: 3D Helmet Dome Cavity Expansion
steps.instruction: Gently insert your thumbs into the bottom opening and expand the cavity outward into a wearable 3D dome!
steps.tip: Pinch the side horn bases slightly so they stand proud and regal on the desk.

japanese-03.title: Sakura — 5-Petal Cherry Blossom
japanese-03.subtitle: Pentagonal radial division • Scalloped petal clefts • Hanami spring icon
japanese-03.description: Symbol of spring, renewal, and the fleeting beauty of life. Features five identical radial petals with delicate V-cleft notches folded from a single pentagonal paper blank.

steps.title: Diagonal Valley Guideline

steps.tip: Line up the tips perfectly and crease firmly across the base.

steps.title: Unfold Flat (Diagonal Crease Memory)
steps.instruction: Open the paper flat back into a square to inspect the diagonal valley guideline.
steps.tip: Keep the sheet square to your desk.

steps.instruction: Fold the bottom edge straight up to meet the top edge in half, like closing a book.
steps.tip: The folded closed edge should be at the bottom.

steps.instruction: Fold the bottom-right corner upward diagonally at 72 degrees to divide the circle into 5 equal petal sectors.
steps.tip: Accurate angle division ensures all 5 cherry blossom petals will be equal.

steps.title: Twin Petal Flap Symmetry Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the left flap across the right folded edge to wrap the sector boundaries together.
steps.tip: Check that the two folded wings align symmetrically.

steps.title: Vertical Centerline Mountain Turnover
steps.instruction: Fold the entire shape backward along the central vertical axis, like closing wings.
steps.tip: All layers are now compressed into a single slender sector wedge.

steps.title: Curved Petal Arc Pre-Crease
steps.instruction: Crease a rounded, curved arc guideline across the top outer layers of the wedge.
steps.tip: This line defines the scalloped curvature of the cherry blossom petals.

steps.title: Five-Petal Radial Fan Expansion
steps.instruction: Carefully unfold the compressed wedge outward to reveal the 5 radiating blossom petals.
steps.tip: Gently flatten each petal flat on the tabletop.

steps.title: Petal Pocket Squash Folds
steps.instruction: Open each of the five folded petal seams and squash them flat into symmetrical heart-shaped petals.
steps.tip: Work around the flower in a clockwise circle for uniform depth.

steps.title: V-Notch Petal Tip Indentations
steps.instruction: Crimp a tiny V-shaped indentation into the outer center tip of each of the 5 petals.
steps.tip: This classic notch gives authentic Japanese Sakura realism.

steps.title: Under-Calyx Petal Curling
steps.instruction: Curl each petal gently backward over your thumb to give the flower organic volumetric curvature.
steps.tip: Soft curves soften the geometric paper lines into botanical beauty.

steps.title: 3D Blossom Core Stature Lock
steps.instruction: Press the center core gently downward while lifting the five petals outward into full spring bloom!
steps.tip: Your finished 5-petal Sakura blossom is ready for exhibition.

steps.instruction: Angle the side fins outward at 15 degrees dihedral to stabilize the windsock in breezy currents.
steps.tip: Check that both fins create balanced lateral lift.

steps.title: Children's Day Flagpole Mount Lock
steps.instruction: Lock the underside belly seam securely and suspend your Koinobori high on its display pole!
steps.tip: Your flying carp is ready to ride the festive spring winds.

japanese-06.description: The sacred benevolent water dragon of Japanese mythology. Features a long sinuous spine, bearded jaws, deer-like horns, and 4 grasping talons.

steps.title: Four Imperial Dragon Limb Splits
steps.instruction: Narrow and split the lower flap legs outward to form the dragon's four muscular talons.

steps.title: Dorsal Spinal Ridge Accordion Pleats
steps.instruction: Pinch a series of alternating mountain and valley pleats along the central back to form serrated spinal scales.
steps.tip: Even 3mm pleats give the dragon an ancient mythical texture.

steps.title: S-Curved Serpentine Neck Reverse Fold
steps.instruction: Inside-reverse-fold the neck upward, then reverse-fold it forward to create an undulating serpentine S-curve.

steps.title: Horned Dragon Head Crimp
steps.instruction: Crimp the head point forward, then reverse-fold the twin antler horns upward behind the crown.

steps.title: Imperial Whisker & Beard Pinches

steps.title: 3D Dynamic Rising Dragon Pose
steps.instruction: Puff the ribcage outward and twist the serpentine body into a dynamic rising spiral into the clouds!

chinese-01.goal: A dimensional boat-shaped golden ingot with elevated central dome and flared curved ends

steps.title: Horizontal Centerline Book Fold
steps.instruction: Place gold foil paper flat on the desk with the gold side facing down. Fold top edge to bottom edge in half.
steps.tip: Crease firmly and evenly across the horizontal center line.

steps.title: Unfold Flat (Centerline Memory)
steps.instruction: Open back flat into a square. Check the clean horizontal guide crease.
steps.tip: Keep the sheet centered on your desk.

steps.title: Top & Bottom Edge Centerline Folds
steps.instruction: Fold both the top edge and bottom edge inward to meet the horizontal center crease.
steps.tip: The paper now forms a neat horizontal rectangle.

steps.title: Pancake Flip (Turn Paper Over)
steps.instruction: Flip the rectangle over like a pancake so the gold foil side is facing up.
steps.tip: Keep the long edges horizontal.

steps.title: Side Margin Vertical Valley Folds
steps.instruction: Fold both the left and right short edges inward about one inch to establish the ingot rims.
steps.tip: Make sure both side margins are equal in width.

steps.title: Four Corner Triangular Squash Folds
steps.instruction: Open each of the four corner pockets and squash them flat into neat 45-degree diagonal triangles.
steps.tip: Press each triangular squash flat to lock the side folds.

steps.title: Inner Oval Lip Valley Folds
steps.instruction: Fold the upper and lower center flaps slightly outward to form the curved oval lips of the wealth ingot.
steps.tip: Curved creases mimic hand-hammered imperial gold bullion.

steps.title: Side Pocket Interlocking Reverse Locks
steps.instruction: Inside-reverse-fold the side triangular flaps into the inner pockets to lock the ingot's curved hull.
steps.tip: This mechanical lock prevents the model from springing open.

steps.title: Hollow Center 3D Expansion
steps.instruction: Gently insert both thumbs into the center opening and push outward to expand the hollow oval interior!
steps.tip: The flat paper blossoms into a volumetric 3D vessel.

steps.title: Curved Boat Rim Modeling Pinches
steps.instruction: Pinch the two elevated side ends upward into traditional boat-shaped prow and stern tips.
steps.tip: The upturned tips represent rising prosperity and abundance.

steps.title: Center Treasure Mound Dome Pinch
steps.instruction: Puff the central inner dome slightly upward to represent the heaped mound of solid gold within the ingot.
steps.tip: A rounded center conveys rich imperial wealth.

steps.title: Auspicious Golden Ingot Staging
steps.instruction: Smooth the outer gold foil facets and rest your completed Yuanbao proudly on its ceremonial plinth!

chinese-02.title: Denglong — Royal Palace Red Lantern

chinese-02.description: Essential celebration icon for Chinese New Year, Lantern Festival, and Mid-Autumn Festival. A spherical red lantern with ribbed facets, gold caps, and a delicate paper tassel.

steps.instruction: Place vermillion paper flat and fold left edge to right edge in half, creasing and unfolding.

steps.title: Gold Foil Trim Modeling

steps.tip: Puffed cheeks give the jack-o'-lantern life and personality.

steps.title: Underside Flat Resting Base Fold
steps.instruction: Press the bottom center slightly inward to create a flat, stable resting base on the table.
steps.tip: Stable base prevents rolling.

steps.title: Spooky Halloween Jack-o'-Lantern Staging
steps.instruction: Place your completed Jack-o'-Lantern on the desk, slip a battery-operated LED candle inside, and let it glow!
steps.tip: Trick or treat! A spooky Halloween masterpiece.

festival-02.title: Halloween Vampire Bat
festival-02.subtitle: Scalloped membrane wings • 3D perched ears • Interlocking claw hooks
festival-02.description: Creature of the autumn night. Features wide scalloped wings with folded finger struts, pointed ears, and claws that allow it to hang upside-down from string.
festival-02.goal: A hanging 3D vampire bat with wide scalloped wings and upside-down hanging hooks

steps.title: Diagonal Foundation (The Giant Wing Triangle)
steps.instruction: Place square bat paper flat with the black side down and purple/white side up. Fold corner to corner into a giant triangle.
steps.tip: Ensure the tips line up with exact precision and slide your index finger across the fold.

steps.title: Unfold Flat (Diagonal Crease Memory)
steps.instruction: Open the paper back into a flat square. Check the deep valley crease crossing the center.
steps.tip: Keep the sheet centered on your desk.

steps.title: Opposite Diagonal Fold (Twin Triangle)
steps.instruction: Fold the other two corners together across the opposite diagonal to form the matching twin triangle.
steps.tip: Line up the tips with razor-sharp accuracy.

steps.title: Unfold Flat (The X-Guide)
steps.instruction: Open flat. Check that the X-crease crosses cleanly at the center point.
steps.tip: Keep the sheet square to your desk.

steps.title: Top Apex Forward Mountain Crimp
steps.instruction: Fold the top corner downward 1/3 of the way down to form the bat's head and pointed snout.
steps.tip: Crease firmly across the brow line.

steps.title: Snout Inversion Valley Pre-Crease
steps.instruction: Fold the tip of the snout back upward slightly, then flatten the snout ridge.
steps.tip: Creates the bat's echolocating nose-leaf.

steps.title: Pointed Ear Inside Reverse Folds
steps.instruction: Inside-reverse-fold the twin side horns upward into tall, erect, pointed vampire bat ears.
steps.tip: Pointed ears are alert to midnight sounds.

steps.title: Wing Strut Accordion Pleats (Bone 1)
steps.instruction: Mountain-fold the left wing backward and valley-fold forward along the first long finger bone line.
steps.tip: Bat wings are membranous hands supported by elongated finger bones.

steps.title: Wing Strut Accordion Pleats (Bone 2)
steps.instruction: Pinch the second elongated finger strut pleat to give the wing authentic bat anatomy.
steps.tip: Even pleats ensure flexible wing flapping motion.

steps.title: Wing Strut Accordion Pleats (Bone 3)
steps.instruction: Repeat the finger bone pleats symmetrically on the right wing for balanced aerodynamic lift.
steps.tip: Symmetrical wings guarantee stable gliding.

steps.title: Scalloped Wing Trailing Edge Crimps
steps.instruction: Crimp small crescent notches between each finger bone along the lower trailing wing edge.
steps.tip: Scalloped trailing edges produce the classic gothic bat silhouette.

steps.title: Hanging Foot Claws Inside Reverse Fold
steps.instruction: Inside-reverse-fold the bottom center point downward into split roosting claws.
steps.tip: The claws allow the bat to hang upside down from cave ceilings.

steps.title: Fangs & Brow Ridge Pinch Modeling
steps.instruction: Pinch the eyebrow ridge and snout forward to reveal the fierce vampire silhouette.
steps.tip: Expressive facial modeling brings the creature to life.

steps.title: 15-Degree Aerodynamic Dihedral Flight Arc
steps.instruction: Curve both wings slightly downward with an aerodynamic dihedral sweep for stable, silent gliding.
steps.tip: Dihedral curvature provides aerodynamic flight stability.

steps.title: 3D Midnight Vampire Bat Flight Lock
steps.instruction: Gently expand the accordion wing pleats and stage your vampire bat swooping through the midnight sky!
steps.tip: A magnificent creature of the night, ready for flight.

festival-03.title: Hanami Chochin — Cherry Blossom Festival Lantern
festival-03.subtitle: Concentric cylindrical paper ribs • Hanami spring pink • Bamboo rim cuff
festival-03.description: The festive paper lantern hung along riverbanks in Japan during cherry blossom season (Hanami). Casts warm, romantic ambient light among blooming sakura branches.
festival-03.goal: A glowing cylindrical paper lantern with pleated ribs and bamboo hanger cuff

steps.title: Vertical Centerline Guideline
steps.instruction: Place cherry blossom pink paper flat and fold left to right in half, creasing and unfolding.
steps.tip: Symmetry axis.

steps.title: Horizontal 12-Rib Accordion Pleat Grid
steps.instruction: Subdivide the paper into 12 equal horizontal accordion pleats across the sheet.
steps.tip: Fine accordion pleating creates the paper lantern ribs.

steps.title: Top & Bottom Collar Cuff Folds
steps.instruction: Fold a 1/2-inch border along the top and bottom edges to form the dark sumi-ink wooden cuffs.
steps.tip: Cuffs anchor the delicate paper ribs.

steps.title: Corner Diagonal Relief Notch Folds
steps.instruction: Fold the four corners inward diagonally at 45 degrees for smooth cylindrical rolling.
steps.tip: Notches prevent paper buckling.

steps.title: Longitudinal Cylinder Wrap Seam
steps.instruction: Roll the pleated paper into a hollow cylinder, overlapping the outer side margins.
steps.tip: Align the horizontal pleats perfectly across the seam.

steps.title: Cuff Interlocking Slot Tucks
steps.instruction: Tuck the overlapping cuff ends into the interlocking tabs to lock the cylinder firmly.
steps.tip: Locks the paper lantern without glue.

steps.title: Parabolic Rib Outward Expansion
steps.instruction: Insert hands into the cylinder and push outward on the ribs while gently compressing the top and bottom cuffs closer together!
steps.tip: The lantern puffs into an elegant rounded oval barrel.

steps.title: Cherry Blossom Sakura Petal Emblem Squash
steps.instruction: Squash-fold the front surface node into a delicate 5-petal cherry blossom festival crest.
steps.tip: The Sakura crest celebrates spring cherry blossom viewing (Hanami).

steps.title: Top Suspension Hook Mountain Fold
steps.instruction: Mountain-fold the upper mounting flap into a sturdy hook for hanging from flowering cherry branches.
steps.tip: Balanced hook ensures the lantern hangs vertical.

steps.title: Lower Festive Tassel Loop Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the lower center flap into a mounting loop for the traditional red silk hanging tassel.
steps.tip: A red tassel sways gently in spring breezes.

steps.title: Pink-to-White Ombre Gradient Smoothing
steps.instruction: Smooth the pleated paper surfaces so the delicate pink-to-white color gradient radiates softly.
steps.tip: Soft ombre gradients mimic real cherry petals.

steps.title: Radial Barrel Symmetry Calibration
steps.instruction: Work around the lantern in a circle, adjusting the tension of all 12 ribs until perfectly round.
steps.tip: Uniform radial curvature ensures festival perfection.

steps.title: Hanami Chochin Cherry Blossom Festival Lantern Staging
steps.instruction: Hang your glowing Hanami lantern beneath the blooming cherry trees and celebrate the arrival of spring!
steps.tip: A gentle lantern glowing with springtime warmth.

festival-04.title: Día de los Muertos Calavera
festival-04.subtitle: Sacred Mexican sugar skull • Deep hollow eye sockets • Marigold flower crown
festival-04.description: Celebration of love and memory for Mexico's Day of the Dead. A sculptural sugar skull with deep faceted eye sockets, toothy grin, and a crown of folded orange marigolds.
festival-04.goal: A striking 3D calavera sugar skull with faceted sunken eye sockets and floral crown
principles: Festive Mexican folk art floral adornment

steps.title: Diagonal Guideline Crease 1
steps.instruction: Place white calavera paper flat on the desk. Fold corner to corner into a triangle and unfold.
steps.tip: Crisp diagonal guide.

steps.title: Diagonal Guideline Crease 2
steps.instruction: Fold across the other diagonal, crease firmly, and unfold flat.
steps.tip: X-crease crosses the center.

steps.title: Skull Cranium Waterbomb Base Collapse
steps.instruction: Push the side edges inward along the creases to collapse into a triangular Waterbomb Base.
steps.tip: The wide top forms the rounded cranium of the skull.

steps.title: Cheekbone Narrowing Angle Folds
steps.instruction: Fold the lower side edges inward diagonally to narrow the skull beneath the cheekbones.
steps.tip: Cheekbone narrowing defines the human skeletal profile.

steps.title: Eye Socket Hollow Squash Folds
steps.instruction: Open the two front diagonal pockets and squash them flat into large, round sunken eye sockets.
steps.tip: Deep eye sockets gaze out with benevolent celebration.

steps.title: Nasal Cavity Inverted Crimp
steps.instruction: Inside-reverse-crimp an inverted heart-shaped notch between the eyes for the nasal cavity.
steps.tip: The inverted heart nose is the universal symbol of the festive sugar skull.

steps.title: Serrated Teeth Accordion Pleats
steps.instruction: Pinch four tiny vertical mountain-valley pleats across the lower jaw to form the smiling teeth.
steps.tip: A wide, grinning smile celebrates life beyond death.

steps.title: Chin & Jawline Angular Locking Tucks
steps.instruction: Fold the bottom chin corners inward to square off the mandible jawline.
steps.tip: A strong jawline locks the teeth pleats securely.

steps.title: Floral Marigold Crown Corner Squashes
steps.instruction: Squash-fold the top cranium corners into colorful decorative marigold flower blossoms (Cempasúchil).
steps.tip: Golden cempasúchil flowers guide returning spirits with their vibrant scent.

steps.title: Folk Art Filigree Mountain Pinches
steps.instruction: Pinch delicate spiral ridges across the forehead and cheeks representing sugar icing decorations.
steps.tip: Intricate icing sugar patterns honor departed loved ones with joyous art.

steps.title: Cranial Vault 3D Expansion
steps.instruction: Gently insert fingers into the underside cavity and expand the skull into a rounded 3D sculpture!
steps.tip: The flat mask puffs into a freestanding sugar skull.

steps.title: Temple Bone Relief Contour Modeling
steps.instruction: Pinch the temple contours slightly inward to accentuate the dramatic orbital ridges.
steps.tip: Anatomical relief gives the skull lifelike depth.

steps.title: Día de los Muertos Calavera Memorial Presentation
steps.instruction: Place your completed Sugar Skull on the festive family ofrenda, surrounded by candles and marigolds!
steps.tip: ¡Feliz Día de los Muertos! Honoring memory, love, and life.

festival-05.title: Lunar New Year Hongbao Envelope
festival-05.subtitle: Traditional auspicious red packet • Interlocking gold foil seal • Spring blessings
festival-05.description: The lucky red envelope gifted during Lunar New Year and weddings to bestow blessings and prosperity. Features an interlocking origami pocket and a folded golden seal.
festival-05.goal: A traditional festive red envelope with functional money pocket and interlocking seal

steps.title: Horizontal Centerline Guideline
steps.instruction: Place festive red paper flat on the desk. Fold lengthwise in half, creasing sharply and unfolding.
steps.tip: Center guideline.

steps.title: Side Margin Hemming Folds
steps.instruction: Fold a 1/2-inch border along the left and right outer edges to create clean reinforced envelope seams.
steps.tip: Clean hemmed seams prevent paper tearing.

steps.title: Bottom Currency Pocket Upward Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the bottom edge upward 2/3 of the way up the sheet to form the deep currency pocket.
steps.tip: The pocket securely holds crisp banknotes for the new year.

steps.title: Side Flap Interlocking Reverse Tucks
steps.instruction: Inside-reverse-fold the side hem tabs into the inner pocket to lock the sides without glue.
steps.tip: Mechanical friction lock keeps the envelope flat and strong.

steps.title: Top Triangular Flap Downward Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the top two corners inward diagonally to form a crisp triangular closure flap.
steps.tip: The triangular flap seals the envelope.

steps.title: Auspicious Golden Seal Blintz Coin
steps.instruction: Fold a small square of gold foil into a 4-corner blintz coin bearing the Chinese character 'Fu' (Blessing).
steps.tip: The golden seal radiates good fortune and prosperity.

steps.title: Closure Slot Precision Crimp Fold
steps.instruction: Crimp a narrow horizontal slot into the front face of the envelope to receive the triangular flap tip.
steps.tip: The slot allows the envelope to be opened and closed gracefully.

steps.title: Flap Tip Insertion Lock
steps.instruction: Tuck the pointed tip of the triangular top flap securely into the golden closure slot.
steps.tip: The envelope is now sealed with auspicious elegance.

steps.title: Gold Foil Border Burnishing
steps.instruction: Smooth the gold foil border accents so they gleam brightly against the imperial red paper.
steps.tip: Red and gold are the supreme colors of joy and wealth in Chinese culture.

steps.title: Four Corner Precision Squaring
steps.instruction: Pinch all four envelope corners firmly with your thumbnail to ensure razor-sharp 90-degree corners.
steps.tip: Crisp corners reflect meticulous craftsmanship.

steps.title: Pocket Expansion Clearance Check
steps.instruction: Gently flex the pocket opening to verify smooth insertion of lucky money bills.
steps.tip: The envelope is ready to receive auspicious gifts.

steps.title: Lunar New Year Hongbao Red Envelope Presentation
steps.instruction: Present your ceremonial Hongbao with both hands, wishing family and friends happiness, health, and prosperity!
steps.tip: Gong Xi Fa Cai! Wishing you great wealth and happiness in the new year.

aerospace-01.title: Aerospace Hypar — Deployable Solar Metamaterial
aerospace-01.subtitle: Curved-Crease Ruled Surface • James Webb Deployer • Zero-Gaussian Curvature
aerospace-01.description: Cutting-edge aerospace origami exploring hyperbolic paraboloid (Hypar) geometry and Miura-ori space array deployment. Features concentric mountain-valley diamond creases that buckle a flat sheet into an ultra-rigid 3D curved saddle.
aerospace-01.goal: A self-locking 3D hyperbolic paraboloid space solar array with zero-Gaussian curvature
principles: Gauss Theorema Egregium (zero Gaussian curvature K = 0)

steps.title: Diagonal Ruled Surface Median Grid
steps.instruction: Place space-grade mylar paper flat on the desk. Score diagonal and horizontal guidelines across the square.
steps.tip: Strict precision in crease angles is required for mathematical bistability.

steps.title: Unfold Flat (Median Crease Memory)
steps.instruction: Open flat to inspect the orthogonal grid intersections.
steps.tip: Lay the paper smooth.

steps.title: Opposite Diagonal Median Grid
steps.instruction: Score the opposite diagonal and vertical grid lines, completing the 8-axis symmetry grid.
steps.tip: All crease lines must intersect with sub-millimeter precision.

steps.title: Concentric Diamond Tessellation Folds
steps.instruction: Score nested concentric diamond rings radiating outward from the central saddle point.
steps.tip: Concentric diamonds allow the flat sheet to buckle into a 3D saddle with zero stretching.

steps.title: Alternating Parity Mountain-Valley Inversion
steps.instruction: Pinch alternating mountain and valley creases around each diamond ring obeying Maekawa's theorem.
steps.tip: Alternating parity is what gives deployable origami metamaterials their negative Poisson ratio.

steps.title: Central Saddle Point Transverse Crimp
steps.instruction: Depress the central intersection downward while pulling opposite corners upward to create the saddle node.
steps.tip: The saddle point has zero Gaussian curvature (K = 0).

steps.title: Kinematic Ruled Saddle Buckling
steps.instruction: Gently compress opposite corners while pushing the center downward to initiate hyperbolic buckling.
steps.tip: The flat sheet spontaneously transitions into a 3D hyperbolic paraboloid (hypar).

steps.title: Dihedral Facet Angle Calibration (112°)
steps.instruction: Crimp the diamond hinges until the dihedral angle between adjacent facets reaches exactly 112 degrees.
steps.tip: Uniform dihedral angles ensure equal solar cell packing density across the array.

steps.title: Bistable Snap-Through Actuation Cycling
steps.instruction: Flex the structure between its two stable mechanical equilibrium states to test bistability.
steps.tip: Bistable snap-through enables motorized satellite deployment with zero auxiliary latches.

steps.title: Perimeter Tension Cable Routing Folds
steps.instruction: Pinch tiny perimeter eyelet creases along the outer diamond vertices for deployment cable routing.
steps.tip: Cables control extension in orbital microgravity.

steps.title: 10x Deployable Space Expansion Test
steps.instruction: Pull diagonally on the outer vertices to demonstrate the rapid 10x deployable space expansion.
steps.tip: NASA uses this folding geometry for compact satellite solar arrays and orbital antennas.

steps.title: Structural Rigidity Deflection Analysis
steps.instruction: Apply edge loads to verify that the ruled surface resists out-of-plane bending through membrane stiffness.
steps.tip: Zero-Gaussian curvature prevents high-stress concentration spots.

steps.title: Spacecraft Gantry Mounting Sockets
steps.instruction: Reverse-fold the four corner nodes to interface with the satellite payload adapter ring.
steps.tip: Standardized aerospace mechanical interface.

steps.title: Aerospace Hypar Deployable Solar Metamaterial Staging
steps.instruction: Mount your deployable space metamaterial on the aerospace gantry test plinth!
steps.tip: A brilliant demonstration of how computational origami powers cutting-edge space exploration.

aerospace-02.title: Falcon Dart — Supersonic Aerodynamic Glider
aerospace-02.subtitle: High-Lift Delta Wing • 15° Dihedral Angle • Trailing Elevator Trim Tabs
aerospace-02.description: Authentic supersonic high-performance paper glider engineered for maximum distance, straight tracking, and long aerodynamic glide times. Features a reinforced locking nose cone, canard weight ballast, dual vertical winglets, and precision elevator trim tabs.
aerospace-02.goal: A high-performance supersonic paper glider capable of 50+ foot smooth aerodynamic flights
principles: Bernoulli aerodynamic lift and laminar camber airflow
Dihedral angle spiral stability (positive roll restoring torque)

steps.title: Longitudinal Fuselage Centerline Fold
steps.instruction: Place rectangular flight paper flat on the desk oriented vertically. Fold lengthwise in half, crease razor-sharp, and unfold.
steps.tip: This line forms the central glide axis and directional thrust vector.

steps.title: Unfold Flat (Fuselage Centerline Memory)
steps.instruction: Open flat back onto the desk. Notice the crisp center groove.
steps.tip: Keep the paper smooth and aligned vertically on your desk.

steps.title: Top-Left 45-Degree Nose Taper Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the top-left corner downward so its top edge aligns flush against the center line.
steps.tip: Form a clean 45-degree angle with the tip at the exact center.

steps.title: Top-Right 45-Degree Nose Taper Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the top-right corner downward to meet the center line, creating a symmetrical triangular nose cone.
steps.tip: Both edges must meet flush with zero gap and zero overlap.

steps.title: Triangular Canard Nose Downward Inversion Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the entire triangular nose point downward toward the trailing edge, creasing horizontally across the base.
steps.tip: This canard fold shifts the aerodynamic center of gravity forward for stable supersonic gliding.

steps.title: Secondary Canard Shoulder Tapers (Left Edge)
steps.instruction: Fold the new top-left diagonal edge inward to meet the vertical center line, leaving 1/2-inch of the nose point visible.
steps.tip: Double nose tapers create a low-drag supersonic needle profile.

steps.title: Secondary Canard Shoulder Tapers (Right Edge)
steps.instruction: Fold the top-right diagonal edge inward with matching precision to meet the center line.
steps.tip: Check that both canard shoulders are perfectly symmetrical.

steps.title: Inverted Nose Locking Tab Upward Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the small exposed triangular tip upward over the folded flaps, locking the nose cone firmly in place.
steps.tip: This locking tab is the mechanical heart of high-performance paper airplanes, preventing nose blowout in flight!

steps.title: Centerline Inverted Mountain Fold (Fuselage Spine)
steps.instruction: Fold the entire plane in half backward along the center line so all folded nose locks are on the outside.
steps.tip: Press firmly through all the layers along the fuselage keel.

steps.title: Port Wing Primary Aerofoil Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the left wing downward so the wing crease runs parallel to the bottom fuselage spine about 3/4-inch up.
steps.tip: A straight, parallel wing root creates clean laminar airflow across the wingspan.

steps.title: Starboard Wing Symmetrical Aerofoil Fold
steps.instruction: Flip the plane over and fold the right wing down with identical angle, height, and wing area.
steps.tip: Hold the plane up to eye level to verify that both wings are identical in size and angle.

steps.title: Port Winglet Vertical Stabilizer Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the outer 1/2-inch tip of the left wing straight up at a 90-degree angle.
steps.tip: Vertical winglets eliminate wingtip vortices and prevent side-slip during high-speed glides.

steps.title: Starboard Winglet Vertical Stabilizer Fold
steps.instruction: Fold the outer tip of the right wing straight up at 90 degrees to match the port winglet.
steps.tip: Symmetrical winglets keep the aircraft flying straight as an arrow.

steps.title: 15-Degree Aerodynamic Dihedral Camber & Trim Flight Test
steps.instruction: Angle both wings slightly upward in a gentle V-shape (15-degree dihedral angle) and crimp 1mm elevator tabs at the trailing edge!
steps.tip: Launch with a smooth, level throw and watch your Falcon Dart glide across the entire room!
